fieldValues.title: Flow model B: an independent model of how work moves
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Made by an agent commissioned on 2026-10-25 that read only what existed before that day (srs-programme at 2dcc58f, srs-context at 5263e9b, clerk at af44be9, the repos' CLAUDE.md files and commands, git history, semops2 and products), and nothing of model A (container 165f3a6e) or its notes. Eight stages, each with one trade-off named in its own words. The cut between Make sense and Rule is the agent's own judgement; the stages nearly match the September unit walk (Ground, Classify, Check charter, Route, Work, Prove, Land, Harvest) and the handbook's flow rows.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- Moderate confidence. Not verified: local plan files, cloud routine logs, the I1 values, private srs-lab content; the 'owner merged every PR' figure is from the audit, not checked per PR.
